questions.q: What did Moloko give to the children as a surprise?
choices: both new soccer kits and balls
questions.explain: Moloko provided both new soccer kits and balls for all the children.

questions.q: Why did Moloko only tell the children about the surprise the next day?
choices: because she wanted to keep them curious
because she didn't have any surprises
because the children were not interested
questions.explain: Moloko wanted to keep the children excited and curious about the surprise.

questions.q: What did the children feel after hearing about the surprise?
questions.explain: The children felt excited about the surprise Moloko had for them.
